skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK Direct DMG to a single target with 2 consecutive strikes.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 3 consecutive strikes to a single target for 1500% ATK as [Specialized Direct DMG] (only affected by high-level DMG Reduction), negating 45% of the target's [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and piercing [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. Heals all allies for 10% Max HP as [Specialized HP] (can crit).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: [Specialized Direct DMG] 1500% > 2400% ATK. Negates [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] 45% > 60%. Heals all allies for 10% > 15% Max HP as [Specialized HP].

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Gains 60% [Specialized Evasion]. Reduces enemies' [Rapid Divinity - ATK] and [Rapid Divinity - DEF] by 40%. Before any character acts, cleanses [Stun], [Specialized Stun] and [Deterrence] from all allies.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: [Specialized Evasion] 70% > 80%. Reduces enemies' [Rapid Divinity - ATK] and [Rapid Divinity - DEF] by 40% > 70%.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: If an ally's Max HP is lower than 70% of Amai Mask's Max HP, permanently increases Max HP by 30%. When battle begins, gains 30% [Reduced DMG from Resistance]. — [Reduced DMG from Resistance]: reduces DMG received by 30%; if original HP is higher than the attacker's, increases to 150%.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Max HP 30% > 50%. [Reduced DMG from Resistance] 30% > 40% (if HP is higher, 150% > 170%).

effects.desc: PvP (advanced) tier of Resilience — shield ignores stronger damage, only penetrated by advanced breakers.
Shield ignores damage from certain attacks. Must be penetrated by Breakthrough or Charge/True DMG.
PvP tier of Stun — harder to resist or resolve.
The stun-type control effect prevents the target from taking action during the duration.
Buff grants 15% damage reduction and condensed defense when the bearer is attacked.
Reduces damage taken by 30%, increasing to a 150% reduction if the bearer's base HP is higher than the attacker's.
The PvP tier's unique health bar stacks on top of regular health, must also be depleted, and can be restored independently.
Evasion PvP tier — reduces specialized attacks to 1 damage; pierced by the ignore dodge effect.
Attack buff allows the bearer to ignore a portion of the enemy's Damage Reduction and Specialized Defense when attacking.
Advanced tier of direct damage, only affected by advanced damage increase/decrease and passes through normal defenses.
Attack speed area index helps increase damage in PvP; Enemies can have Hyperspeed Field·ATK reduced (e.g. 40–60%) to weaken attacks.
Defense zone is based on speed, reducing damage taken in PvP when the attacker's speed is no higher than the defender's.
The stun control effect renders the target unable to act and reduces its overall damage immunity by 30%.
